narrative:
Geauga County has 67,110 registered voters, with 22.7% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 39.7%, a clear Democratic lean of 8.0 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 32.2% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -6.4% D−R vs -23.7% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
